purpose: The developer-capabilities band of a product page: a large section title over a sticky stack whose claims scroll past a pinned media frame, the open claim showing its one-file code sample on the pixelate texture and its own button under its description. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'sticky-scroll-code', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `sticky-stack`, `texture-material`, `code-block` and `button`. Which claim is open is scroll-driven state owned by `sticky-stack`.
useWhen: To walk a developer through several capabilities, each proven by a short file, while the page scrolls.
avoidWhen: For one claim beside one sample → use `code-split`.
For a walkthrough shown by illustrations → use `feature-scroll`.
related: sticky-stack` — the pinned, scroll-driven run of claims this section renders through.
code-block` — the one-file sample each claim shows.
bestPractices: Keep each sample short enough to read in the pinned frame.
Give every item a `code`; the item's `action` is optional and shows only while the item is open.
